items.title: Venus Retrograde 2026: DAGGERS & DELIGHTS!
items.summary:
What can 2nd Century astrologer Antiochus and the movie Legally Blonde teach us about Venus retrograde in Scorpio and Libra? 

Kepler College instructor Joey Cannizzaro interviews Skye Barclay about her new book tailor-made for this Venus retrograde: 2026 Venus Retrograde: A Dance of Daggers and Delights. An innovative workbook and transit guide, it offers a variety of different access points for readers to connect to the energy of this moment in a more embodied, playful, and intuitive way. Among other brilliant Venusian insights, Skye uses her own experience with braiding, maintaining, and re-braiding black hair as a model for Venus' phases of visibility and invisibility in relationship to the sun. Throughout their conversation, Skye and Joey take concepts and frameworks from ancient astrology and ground them in our contemporary moment, showing how ideas and techniques from 2000 years ago resonate with the stories we tell and the lives we live today. 

To join Joey's class, 'Planetary Condition in Natal Hellenistic Astrology: Essential Dignity', visit: https://store.keplercollege.org/product/planetary-condition-in-natal-hellenistic-astrology-essential-dignity-2/

items.title: October Astrology Forecast 2026
items.summary:
A detailed look at the astrology forecast for October 2026, with astrologer Chris Brennan. 

This month is dominated by a tumultuous Venus retrograde in Scorpio, kicking off alongside intense hard aspects to Mars and Pluto, which will dredge up some challenging things from the past.

Tensions are further heightened as Mercury slows down and stations retrograde in Scorpio later in the month, bringing communication breakdowns and the need for significant retooling.

I explore the historical precedents for these transits and break down how to navigate this tough astrological weather before the planets finally station direct and offer resolution in mid-November.

This is episode 551 of The Astrology Podcast.
